Daily Devotional

September 13

19 For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He taketh the wise in their own craftiness. 20 And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain. (1 Corinthians 3:19-20 KJV)

These verses are quoting Old Testament Scriptures (Job 5:13 & Psalms 94:11). Paul has been showing how the wisdom of God was so very superior to the wisdom of man. Even though many people would agree to that being true in Paul’s day, few would agree that it is still so very true. Man tends to put his wisdom above all other knowledge, and certainly above God’s wisdom. Even though we think we are so very smart, we can’t even make life in the test tube. Man will never be able to create life that will reproduce on its own.

People would certainly disagree that the “thoughts of the wise” were vain, as we think we are so superior to everything else. To even think that our smartest, well educated, people are not very wise in God’s eyes, is just not what conceited man can acknowledge. That is one reason why man keeps messing with God’s creation, by trying to improve on nature by changing the way that plants reproduce, etc. We like to think we are certainly smarter than God is, and that His Word, that is thousands of years old, just doesn’t apply to us now, as it is outdated. WRONG! God’s Word will be relevant forever, and it will never change (Matthew 24:35). Praise God for His Word!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
